description: Na₃MgBiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent BiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and two longer (2.03 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent BiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Bi atoms to form distorted ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₅Bi pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Bi pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-41°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₅Bi pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra, edges with four equivalent ONa₃MgBi₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₅Bi pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 76°.
